text: Type a question and press Send, or tap one of the Try asking ideas. The answer appears word by word. Every answer says "ARAW practice AI · can be wrong". When a chat touches something AI often gets wrong, Ara adds a tip under the answer.
AI has no clock. It only knows what it learned before, so it cannot tell the date unless an app gives it. That is why you check anything recent.
This link may not be real. AI can make up links that look right. Check it yourself before you trust it, and never type personal details there.
AI can make up numbers that sound exact. Check numbers on an official page like DOH or WHO.
A chatbot cannot examine you, so it cannot promise you will be okay. Sounding kind is not the same as being right. Ask a health worker.
AI only knows what it learned before, so it can miss new events or give old facts. Check anything recent on an official page or trusted news.
AI can make up studies and sources that sound real. When an answer matters, find the source yourself, like DOH or WHO.
Does it know? An AI has no clock of its own.
